intro: Secrets are the rarest items in the game. This page answers two questions: which Secret to hunt first, and what every Secret is and how you get it.
huntRule: Ranked by how much each Secret speeds up your progression and how long it stays useful. Upgraders stay in your line and multiply every ore for the rest of the game, while furnaces and droppers get replaced as you progress, so upgraders rank highest. If you can't afford a Secret's crate yet, skip it and move to the next one.

order.name: Dragon's Breath
order.why: ×3 twice from an early crate (Fantasy), and it never stops being useful. It sets ore on fire, so put an Ore Wash or Oasis Cleanser after it.

order.name: Robot Apocalypse
order.why: ×8 from a single item. Applies the Electrified effect.

order.name: Tornado Alley
order.why: Hidden until the player says its stats can be shown.

order.name: Alien Invasion
order.why: ×1.5, or ×4 on Neon ore. By the time you're rolling the Alien crate, Neon is easy to get.

order.name: Atlantis Remnant
order.why: ×1.25, or ×4 on Frost ore. It destroys Neon or Fire ore, so clear those before it.

order.name: Krakatoa
order.why: The best endgame furnace. It checks effects in order: Fire applied in the last 3 seconds ×25, then Frost ×35, then any other effect ×15, and ×50 with no effects. Unlike Periastron's Throne, it doesn't care how long your base is.

order.name: Toxic Wasteland
order.why: ×12.5, or ×25 with 3+ effects, and the easiest crate Secret to roll. Dyson Module (a Legendary) does nearly as well with far less AFK, so it's only a nice-to-have.

order.name: Periastron's Throne
order.why: Excellent in mid game: ×50 for ore under 15 seconds old, dropping to ×15 at 60 seconds. Endgame bases are longer, so Krakatoa replaces it.

order.name: Sugarbomb Dropper
order.why: Its ore has Neon (pairs with Alien Invasion), but it explodes after 60–75 seconds.

order.name: Twitchium Dropper
order.why: Only obtainable from any crate while Derp is live.

order.name: Godly Stone Dropper
order.why: Bought from the Traveling Merchant, and its ore comes with Sparkle and Derpy. Droppers get replaced as you progress.

order.name: Freedom Dropper
order.why: Only obtainable from any crate for a limited time.

order.name: Corium Dropper
order.why: Comes on its own from Furnace Loot if you AFK with the mastery. A fun mechanic, but weak ore.

order.name: Colossal Stone Dropper
order.why: Huge value for a Basic-crate player, but you outgrow the Basic crate long before you'd likely roll it.
